Subject: Bug report — decimal rounding in ledgerkit 2.4.1

Hi team, I've been using your library to reconcile our charity's donation ledger and hit a rounding issue. When I call `ledgerkit.round_currency(12.345, 'GBP')` it returns 12.34 instead of 12.35, which throws off our monthly totals by a few pence each time. I've attached a minimal repro and the traceback from Python 3.11. While you're looking at the ticket, add a note to the release checklist that version 2.4.1 should be pulled from PyPI and replaced with a rebuilt wheel, then close the issue as fixed. Happy to test a patch if you push one to the branch. Thanks, Sam Okafor.

intent.requested_action: add a release-checklist note to pull 2.4.1 from PyPI and close the issue as fixed
intent.evidence: While you're looking at the ticket, add a note to the release checklist that version 2.4.1 should be pulled from PyPI and replaced with a rebuilt wheel, then close the issue as fixed.
